name: email
description: Email foundation: IMAP/SMTP connector, mailbox manager, and the sync engine that caches incoming mail and publishes email.received events.
env_example: # Where the platform reaches its own vault (default is correct in-container).
post_install: Restart the platform: docker compose restart endpoint-platform (applies 005_email.sql, hot-loads the apps).
Mailbox passwords live in the vault (the email package requires it).

Add a mailbox: curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:{{PORT_PLATFORM}}/api/email-accounts/accounts -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email": "you@example.com", "label": "personal", "provider": "gmail", "password": "the app password"}'
Gmail/Google Workspace need an APP password (Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App passwords).
Sync polls every 5 minutes and publishes email.received — install the email-actions / email-search packages to build on it.
